summary: No documentation changes needed. The diff updates src/robotsix_memory/main.py to drive the FastAPI served version from the installed distribution package version (via importlib.metadata, falling back to "0.0.0" for source checkouts) instead of the hardcoded stale "0.1.0". The README API table lists routes but does not reference a specific version string, and no other documentation mentions the stale version, so the fix is fully covered by the code change itself. No doc files were modified.
updated_memory: robotsix-memory is a FastAPI wrapper exposing /remember, /recall, /reflect, /chat-skill, /health, /health/live. README at root covers architecture, API table, and dev commands; no docs/ directory. API version is now driven from the installed dist version (importlib.metadata, fallback '0.0.0') in src/robotsix_memory/main.py. No version strings are hardcoded in any doc.
